Aim guard state - global across the menu tree.
Protects submenu traversal when user is moving toward an open submenu.

props.description: Whether aim guard is currently active

props.name: guardedTriggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger being guarded (the submenu trigger the user is moving toward)

props.description: Surface ID that owns the guarded trigger

props.name: timeoutId
props.description: Timeout ID for auto-clearing the guard

PopupMenuControl.name: PopupMenuControl
PopupMenuControl.doc:
Popup menu control is identical to the base menu control.
No additional functionality for popup menus (dropdown, context).

props.name: getState
props.description:
Get current control state (read-only).
Used internally for checking disabled state.

props.name: disable
props.description:
Disable the entire menu (input, items, navigation).
User can still close the menu with Escape.
Emits 'menu-disable' event.

props.name: enable
props.description:
Enable the menu (if it was disabled).
Emits 'menu-enable' event.

props.name: setDisabled
props.description:
Set the disabled state of the menu.
Emits 'menu-disable' or 'menu-enable' event.
